summary: Phase 2 (antd removal + client-side image compression/progress) frontend verification. CRITICAL suspected regression NOT reproduced: hard-load (page.goto) to each lazy route rendered real content within seconds with zero page errors and zero chunk failures. Skeletons.jsx antd removal works. Admin ImageUpload with progress bar works end-to-end. All 4 role panels load after OTP login.

/login.content: OTP login page with phone input and marketing hero

detailed_findings.note_on_screenshot_tool_artifact: The main agent's earlier observation of a stuck spinner was a screenshot-tool artifact. Real Playwright hard-navigation confirms all lazy routes render real content on direct URL load. The transient spinner captured earlier was the normal Suspense fallback shown for ~1s while the route chunk downloads.

antd_removal.notes: No console message containing 'antd' anywhere. /services skeleton→grid transition clean. Media Library page renders and no runtime errors related to removed Skeleton usage.

critical_code_review_comments: cdn-cgi/rum? occasionally fails with ERR_ABORTED — this is Cloudflare RUM beacon and harmless, ignore.
adminSectionsPro.jsx is quite large (~900+ lines with many ImageUpload usages) — consider splitting by section in a future refactor, not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 verified: antd fully removed without regression; new imageUpload.js pipeline (compressImage + XHR progress) works end-to-end with data-testid image-upload-btn and image-upload-pct.
